articles.title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute
articles.snippet: Fintech firms could lead stablecoin ventures, but banks would need to own more than half of any issuer.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
articles.snippet: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

articles.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
articles.snippet: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

articles.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
articles.snippet: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

articles.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
articles.snippet: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.
